Cortex for Antigravity v1.0.0 — Verification Report
Date: 2026-10-02

RESULT: PASS

Automated test suite:
- 16 tests passed
- 0 failed

Covered behavior:
- DockyardOS repository hard-block
- foreign-orchestrator default block
- observer mode has no execution authority
- workspace-only Cortex plugin installation
- Git-local excludes prevent Cortex workspace files from appearing in normal git status/commits
- stable project identity and isolated state
- stale-checkpoint reconciliation
- resume capsule trusts current repository state
- hot/warm/cold context prioritization
- UI/debug task routing
- namespaced skill rewriting
- redacted deterministic secret scan
- trusted static skill installation using a local Git source, exact commit provenance and no upstream installer execution
- native project verification command execution
- Antigravity PreInvocation context hook
- event capture / completion-gate Stop hook
- observer-mode hook passivity

Static/package verification:
- package identity and plugin namespace validated
- plugin hooks and disabled-by-default Inspo MCP config validated
- allow-listed catalog uniqueness and HTTPS GitHub sources validated
- all bundled skills contain frontmatter
- extension, core modules and plugin scripts pass `node --check`
- source ZIP archive integrity: PASS
- VSIX archive integrity: PASS
- plugin ZIP archive integrity: PASS
- source ZIP extracted to a clean directory and full `node scripts/verify.js` rerun: PASS
- VSIX extracted and extension/plugin manifests + JavaScript syntax checked: PASS
- plugin ZIP extracted and hook/plugin checks rerun: PASS

Network limitation during build verification:
The build container cannot resolve github.com, so live `git clone` of the public skill allow-list could not be executed here. The installer itself was tested end-to-end using a real local Git repository. Current upstream repository/path assumptions were separately checked using current web documentation/search. At runtime, Cortex records clone/fetch failures instead of treating a missing skill as installed.

Security defaults:
- third-party install scripts are never executed by Cortex skill installation
- skill copies are namespaced `cortex-*`
- symlinks and oversized skill payloads are rejected
- Inspo MCP disabled by default
- external scanners disabled by default
- Strix requires explicit authorized configuration
- built-in secret findings are redacted
- Cortex state lives outside project repositories
